BETA Close X CRH plc announced on March 11, 2026, that it repurchased 30,248 ordinary shares on March 10, 2026, for an aggregate volume-weighted average price of $106.5176 per share, with individual transactions ranging from $105.44 to $107.89. These repurchases are part of CRH's intention to buy back up to $300 million in shares by April 28, 2026, following its February 18, 2026, announcement. Following these transactions, CRH will have 669,399,849 ordinary shares in issue, with 35,643,874 shares held in treasury, representing 5.056% of the issued ordinary share capital. Disclaimer* 11 th March 2026 CRH plc Transaction in Own Shares CRH plc (“ CRH ”) announces that on 10 th March 2026 it acquired the following number of its ordinary shares (the “ ordinary shares ”) in the United States through CRH’s broker Wells Fargo Securities, LLC. The ordinary shares acquired (by way of redemption) will be cancelled.
